title: Qualify a new isolated net11 Statistics and Quantities package candidate
commitMessage: test: qualify isolated net11 Statistics package candidate

contribution.summary: Build and qualify a new two-node net11 candidate graph with a source-free locked consumer, no publication.
contribution.value: RS339 succeeded first-pass under DWF 0.1.76 and retained incomplete C02 acceptance. RS340 builds a new unpublished two-node net11/C#15 Statistics and Quantities candidate in a disposable workspace from tracked copies of the actual source projects. Quantities is packed first; the copied Statistics project replaces its original project edge with an exact candidate package dependency, and is then packed. A separate source-free consumer restores only these two candidate archives into an isolated cache, locks the exact graph, checks package and binary identities, executes the existing twelve-check fixture and refuses a changed version under locked restore. Existing production files and immutable private packages are preserved. This is bounded candidate evidence, not production migration, publication, phase closure or universal compatibility.
debtChanges: Build new candidate-only net11/C#15 archives from tracked source copies and verify the exact Statistics-to-Quantities package edge.
Reuse the existing twelve-check fixture, isolate the feed and caches, and refuse wrong locked candidate version.
Preserve immutable published archives, original production sources and SDK, and incomplete C02 disposition.
Preselection failure CS7034/CS7035: separate calendar NuGet PackageVersion from the unchanged valid source Version and CLR assembly/file versions; no allocated attempt.
contribution.nextAction: Review the durable candidate proof and reconcile the targeted migration requirement independently before any phase closure.
